beats.care: Expect more apps and helplines that talk in your language, and changes to entry-level support jobs.
beats.what: AI voice company ElevenLabs says it will invest hundreds of millions of dollars in India.
beats.why: India is its second-biggest market, and voice AI that speaks Indian languages is a giant opportunity.

cards.body: ElevenLabs makes AI that talks like a human. It told Reuters it will invest hundreds of millions of dollars in India: hiring people here, building new models, and getting better at Indian languages.
India is now its second-biggest market after the US. PhysicsWallah, Havells and Razorpay already use it.
cards.caption: Indian languages its AI already speaks

cards.body: India has 22 official languages, and tons of people would rather speak than type. If AI can talk to everyone in their own language, that's a giant market.
cards.title: why India?

cards.body: That super-patient support person on the phone might soon be AI. ElevenLabs' boss says this moves simple support jobs toward more complex ones. Good if you learn new skills; scary if you were counting on a basic call-centre job.

a.body: Apps and government services in Telugu, Tamil or Bhojpuri help people who don't read English.
a.label: The 'this is great' side

b.body: Entry-level support jobs are how many people start working. AI taking those hurts first-jobbers the most.
b.label: The 'wait a sec' side

cards.why: India is its second-biggest market, right after the US.
